categories.main_business_segments: Meiko Electronics primarily operates in the electronic circuit board business, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and sales of printed circuit boards (PCBs) and related electronic components. The company also engages in electronic device manufacturing services (EMS) and has recently expanded into semiconductor package substrates and module substrates. Other business activities, such as solar power generation, are considered minor and not material to overall operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include advanced PCB manufacturing methods such as build-up, high heat dissipation, high-density interconnect, and flexible PCB technologies. Meiko develops high-precision multilayer boards, high-frequency and millimeter-wave boards for 5G, metal-based and copper inlay boards for high current and heat resistance, and embedded component boards. The company emphasizes R&D in next-generation automotive, 5G, and AI-related substrates, collaborating with material suppliers and research institutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Meiko serves major set manufacturers in the automotive, smartphone, information and communications, amusement, smart home appliance, and industrial equipment sectors. Key end markets include automotive electronics, mobile devices, data centers, telecommunications infrastructure, and industrial automation. The company is strengthening its presence in semiconductor packaging and automotive-related electronics.
categories.geographic_coverage: Meiko operates globally with major manufacturing and sales bases in Japan, China (Guangzhou, Wuhan), and Vietnam (Hanoi, Hai Duong, Hoa Binh). Sales are distributed across Japan, Vietnam, China, the United States, other Asian countries, and Europe, with significant revenue contributions from both domestic and overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Meiko is positioned as a midstream and downstream supplier, providing critical electronic substrates and modules that are integrated into end products by OEMs and set manufacturers. The company also offers EMS (electronics manufacturing services), further integrating downstream in the value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, Meiko is focused on strengthening its core PCB business while expanding into semiconductor package substrates and automotive electronics. R&D priorities include high-speed transmission, high heat dissipation, miniaturization, and high-density packaging for next-generation vehicles, 5G/AI applications, and environmentally friendly products. The company is also investing in smart factory automation, productivity improvements, and ESG initiatives such as carbon neutrality and diversity.
categories.revenue_model: Meiko generates revenue primarily through the sale of PCBs, electronic modules, and EMS services to OEMs and set manufacturers. Revenue is recognized upon delivery or customer acceptance of products, with the majority of transactions being product-based sales. The company also receives some revenue from solar power generation and licensing of proprietary technologies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include global and regional PCB manufacturers such as Ibiden, CMK, Kyocera, and Chinese and Southeast Asian PCB firms. Meiko is positioned as a leading Japanese PCB supplier with strong overseas manufacturing capabilities and a growing presence in high-value-added segments like automotive and semiconductor substrates. The company differentiates itself through advanced technology, quality, and global production footprint.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ended March 2025, Meiko reported consolidated sales of 206.8 billion yen, a 15.2% year-on-year increase, with operating profit of 19.1 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 14.9 billion yen. The company has demonstrated robust growth over the past five years, with significant investments in capacity expansion and R&D. Total assets reached 256.4 billion yen, and the company maintains a solid equity ratio above 40%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Meiko emphasizes its ability to deliver high-quality, high-reliability, and technologically advanced PCBs and modules tailored to demanding applications such as automotive, 5G, and AI. The company’s value proposition centers on its integrated global production system, rapid response to customer needs, advanced R&D, and commitment to sustainability and ESG. Meiko differentiates itself through its expertise in high-density, high-performance substrates and its ability to support customers with one-stop solutions from design to mass production.
